cases.name: downgrade_stripped_suite_fails_commitment
cases.why: a MITM removes the strong suite so the payer sees a menu of one. offer_commit covers the whole FullOffer, so the substitution is caught BEFORE any suite is chosen — negotiating first would mean selecting from an attacker-chosen menu and only then noticing.

cases.name: commitments_are_domain_separated_by_purpose
cases.why: the same canonical bytes must produce a different digest per role, so a commitment computed for one purpose cannot be presented as another
